subject: Whistic: CAIQ gating & evidence collection cadence
body:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@evergreenhealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic CAIQ extract + presign window

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this on. We've been working our intake for the SIG/CAIQ pass-through and the security team asked whether Redwood can: 

1) Provide a CAIQ extract (CSV) mapped to Whistic question IDs so our compliance team can reconcile answers programmatically.
2) Accept presigned S3 uploads for a short window (we have ~60MB of attachments) and confirm the KMS key used to sign the uploads.
3) Share SOC 2 evidence pointers (page numbers or section ids) so we can link items in our SIG collector.

We'd like to run a two-week evidence sprint starting next Wed (June 9). Can Redwood commit to a presign window during that week? If helpful I've attached our current CAIQ extract for reference.

[Attachment: evergreen_caiq_extract.csv (csv)]

Appreciate a quick confirmation and any pre-kickoff notes.

Warmly,
Sanjay Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager
Evergreen Health

-----Original Message Follows Above-----

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic CAIQ extract + presign window

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear list.

Short answer: yes, we can do all three. A few quick asks to make the sprint predictable:

- Can you highlight the top 10 Whistic question IDs you consider blockers (if you have them)? That helps us map priorities.
- We'll provide a CAIQ->Whistic mapping template. I'll attach the mapping template (Excel) and a suggested upload pattern for presigned objects.
- For KMS: we can provide the KMS key fingerprint and a short summary of rotation cadence; Markus will outline the exact log artifacts we can produce.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30m kickoff on Wed 2027-06-09 at 10am PT to align on Qs and upload windows.
- Presign window: we can open a 4-hour presign window on Thu 2027-06-10 from 09:00-13:00 PT (adjustable). Please confirm if that fits your intake ops.

Attaching: redwood_caiq-mapping-template.xlsx (template for CAIQ->Whistic columns).

Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Vendor Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_caiq-mapping-template.xlsx (xlsx)]

-----Original Message Follows Above-----

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@evergreenhealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic CAIQ extract + presign window

Hi all — tactical notes from the vendor-security side for the kickoff: 

1) Mapping approach
- We'll return a CSV where each row is a CAIQ control ID with three columns: Redwood_answer (Y/N/Partial), Evidence_path (S3 presign path), and SOC2_pointer (report page/section). Please use the template Lauren attached.

2) Evidence types we need to accept
- PDFs (SOC 2, architecture diagrams), CSVs (logs, extracts), and .eml for configuration export. Maximum single-object size: 100MB.

3) KMS proof and logs
- We can provide: KMS key alias, last_rotation_timestamp, and CloudTrail KMS:Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events covering the presign window. We cannot share full key material.

4) Privacy/PII handling
- If any documents include PII, mark them in the filename (e.g., _PII) and we'll route them to an encrypted bucket with stricter retention.

5) Deliverables before the call (Lauren/Camila/Markus)
- Redwood: pre-populated mapping skeleton for 30 most common SIG controls (we'll attach a filled sample row set).
- Evergreen: top-10 Whistic question IDs + any special handling requests.

I've attached a quick sample mapping I filled with two example rows to show format.

[Attachment: caiq_mapping_template_filled.csv (csv)]

Camila Reyes
Vendor Security Program
Redwood Inference

-----Inline from Markus Klein-----
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@evergreenhealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic CAIQ extract + presign window

Quick KMS clarifications:
- Presign uses a GenerateDataKey call and we log the KMS:GenerateDataKey and kms:Encrypt events. We'll deliver a CloudTrail snippet (JSON lines) for the presign range showing request timestamps and request IDs.
- Rotation: last rotation 2027-03-01T02:00:00Z; rotation cadence 90 days.
- We can also sign a short attestation PDF stating we used AWS KMS alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/redwood-presign for the sprint.

Markus Klein
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message Follows Above-----

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, procurement@evergreenhealth.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic CAIQ extract + presign window

Lauren / Camila / Markus —

This is great, thanks. We've got the top-10 Whistic question IDs attached (separate doc in our tracker) and June 9 at 10am PT works for the kickoff. 

A couple of follow-ups before the call: 
- Can you upload a short SOC 2 pointer doc that lists which sections map to SIG control families? Even a single page PDF with page->control mapping will be ideal for our auditors.
- Please confirm the presign window for June 10 can be bumped by +1 hour to 10:00-14:00 PT to align with our ops.
- We'll need a one-page SOW addendum for the upload assistance (SOW draft attached) so we can log the activity in our change management. If you can provide a DocuSign-ready SOW by EOD Friday that'd keep procurement happy.

Attaching: sow_draft_v2.pdf (pdf)

If all good, I'll send a calendar invite for the kickoff and share our Whistic question export there.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager
Evergreen Health
[Attachment: sow_draft_v2.pdf (pdf)]

-----END OF THREAD-----
